scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('dist');for(const n of fs.readdirSync('.')){if(['dist','node_modules','.git','package-lock.json'].includes(n))continue;fs.cpSync(n,p.join('dist',n),{recursive:true})}console.log('Static site staged into dist for Cloudflare.')"
